summary: Comprehensive testing of dashboard redesign, CSV filtering, and hospital/surgeon CRUD features completed. Backend: 100% pass (16/16 tests). Frontend: 100% pass (all features working). All new features verified: Dashboard with expandable sections (Today's Roster, This Month, Previous Month, All Cases), CSV modal with quarterly/yearly filtering, Hospital and Surgeon AddablePicker dropdowns with 'Add New' functionality, and full CRUD operations for hospitals and surgeons collections.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, should use 'boxShadow'
react_native_issues.note: Cosmetic warning only, not breaking functionality. Same as previous iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ GET /api/hospitals returns list of hospitals sorted by name
✅ POST /api/hospitals creates new hospital with UUID and trims whitespace
✅ DELETE /api/hospitals/{id} deletes hospital and returns 404 for nonexistent
✅ GET /api/surgeons returns list of surgeons sorted by name
✅ POST /api/surgeons creates new surgeon with UUID and trims whitespace
✅ DELETE /api/surgeons/{id} deletes surgeon and returns 404 for nonexistent
✅ GET /api/cases/export/csv?period=quarterly&year=2026&quarter=1 filters Q1 cases (Jan, Feb, Mar)
✅ GET /api/cases/export/csv?period=quarterly&year=2026&quarter=2 filters Q2 cases (Apr, May, Jun)
✅ GET /api/cases/export/csv?period=yearly&year=2026 filters all 2026 cases
✅ GET /api/cases/export/csv?period=all returns all cases regardless of date
✅ CSV export defaults to 'all' when no period parameter provided
✅ CSV filename changes based on period: cases_Q1_2026.csv, cases_2026.csv, cases_all.csv
✅ Dashboard shows 4 expandable sections: Today's Roster, This Month, Previous Month, All Cases
✅ Each section header shows count badge with number of cases
✅ Sections expand and collapse on tap with chevron icon animation
✅ Today's Roster section expanded by default, others collapsed
✅ Stats row displays: Cases count, Received amount, Pending amount
✅ CSV button opens modal with title 'Export Cases (CSV)' and subtitle 'Select period for tax/accounting'
✅ CSV modal shows period options: Q2 2026, Q1 2026, Year 2026, Year 2025, All Cases
✅ CSV modal can be closed with Escape key
✅ Hospital field in Add Case form uses AddablePicker component
✅ Surgeon field in Add Case form uses AddablePicker component
✅ AddablePicker shows dropdown with existing items sorted alphabetically
✅ AddablePicker has 'Add New' button at bottom of dropdown
✅ Clicking 'Add New' shows input field with Cancel and Add buttons
✅ Adding new hospital via AddablePicker creates hospital in backend and sets field value
✅ Adding new surgeon via AddablePicker creates surgeon in backend and sets field value
✅ Cases save correctly with hospital and surgeon names from dropdowns
✅ Hospital and surgeon names display in case cards on dashboard
✅ All MongoDB _id fields properly excluded from responses
✅ All new endpoints follow async/await patterns with proper error handling
✅ All interactive elements have proper testID attributes for testing
✅ AddablePicker component is reusable for both hospitals and surgeons
✅ CSV filtering logic correctly parses DD/MM/YYYY date format
✅ Dashboard grouping logic correctly identifies today's date and current/previous month
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing: TEST_Playwright Hospital 2, TEST_Dr. Playwright 2, TEST_Final Patient case. Test cases from CSV filtering tests were cleaned up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 4 features verified working. Dashboard redesigned with expandable sections (Today's Roster, This Month, Previous Month, All Cases) that toggle on tap. CSV export now modal-based with quarterly/yearly filtering via query params (period, year, quarter). Hospital and Surgeon fields use AddablePicker component with dropdown + 'Add New' inline creation. Backend has full CRUD for /api/hospitals and /api/surgeons collections. All features integrate correctly - cases save with hospital/surgeon from dropdowns and display in dashboard.
